notes.title: Georgianna is schedule for release this July
notes.content: [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28634870/6f77adbb21ae74bafec1e905266acbc4a2012600.jpg[/img]Georgianna's Solo Mission has been scheduled to release 20 of July. Live the legends of the heaven spy in a solo sneak mission. Use flying machines , zip lines and new fantastic features. Uproot the evil that hangs, and end slavery in the area, almost single handed. Your imagination will be your only limit!

notes.title: Patch v0.36
notes.content:
[h1]General Updates - Effecting all scenes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Ability Learn Canvases and Shop Canvases Made for all resolutions
[*]Mini-Map Improvements (Healer Signs , and quest signs) 
[*]World Map is now accessible using M or the representative icon
[*]Controls Reporting can be now found on the menu panel (ESC button)
[*]Skip dialog is now possible using -Enter-
[*]Ability Icons are been replaced with their final versions
[*]The characters wait for the player in the follow up quests
[*]Save Stability has been improved in all levels.

[h1]The following  Skills have been added [/h1]
[*]Kick - Pushes back enemies
[*]Triple strike is now working properly 
[*]Power Strike - a double hit that causes 5 times your normal damage
[*]Shield bash  - Pushes back enemies and damages them
[*]Shield Block - Improves defense for a period of time
[*]Vigilance - Improves combat condition for a period of time
[*]Rage - Improves damage reduce defense
[*]Enrage Cleaver - Increase critical for a period of time
[/list]
